# Get help with GraphHelm

GraphHelm is experimental and has no paid support or guaranteed response time. The fastest route is to name the exact commit, command or journey, platform, and sanitized result.

| Need | Route |
| --- | --- |
| First local run | [README](../README.md#try-it-locally) and [offline quickstart](../QUICKSTART.md) |
| Runtime, Studio, and chat setup | [Getting started](../docs/install/GETTING_STARTED.md) |
| Find a contract or specification | [Documentation index](../docs/INDEX.md) |
| Ask a usage question | [Question form](https://github.com/stabem/GraphHelm/issues/new/choose) |
| Report a reproducible defect | [Bug form](https://github.com/stabem/GraphHelm/issues/new/choose) |
| Propose a capability | [Proposal form](https://github.com/stabem/GraphHelm/issues/new/choose) |
| Report a vulnerability | [Private security form](../SECURITY.md) |
| Report abusive GitHub content | [Community conduct policy](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) |

Issues are public. Remove credentials, private paths, and personal data before posting. If no available guide solves the problem, say where you got stuck; the answer can improve the documentation for the next person.
